I would like if she could have pajamas on, but her pajamas are coming off a little bit from her rolling around in bed. I would like if she could be drawn in a sprawled out sleeping pose with her pajama top coming up a bit, and her pajamas bottoms being pulled down a bit. If you could draw her drooling as she sleeps, or with a little snot bubble to convey her deep sleep, that would be cute!

The image should be suggestive. Feel free to do any camera angle or pose for her you would like.

Thank you very much for considering my request!
